metadata.title: Env Vault
metadata.description: A single source of truth for every environment variable across your projects.

notFound.title: Project not found

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Enter the admin credentials to access the vault.
login.secureNote: Values are encrypted with AES-256-GCM and only decrypted on demand.

keys.label: Keys only
keys.hint: Missing keys are created with empty values to fill in later. No secret values are copied.

values.label: Keys and values
values.hint: Values are copied as-is and re-encrypted for the target environment.

compare.caption: Which keys exist in each environment
